== Notes ==
*Despite not scaling with Marksmanship, this skill benefits from the critical rate increase offered by the attribute.
*This skill works well with [[Incendiary Arrows]] to interrupt multiple foes.
*To increase the frequency of interrupts, consider skills that increase [[attack speed]].
*To increase the reliability to interrupt, consider skills such as [[Dual Shot]], [[Triple Shot]] and [[Forked Arrow]]. Primary [[assassin]]s can utilize the skills [[Way of the Master]] and [[Critical Eye]] to raise their critical chance as well.
** Non-primary assassins may find the effect of these uninvested skills too weak to deserve a skill slot.
* In [[PvE]], one may consider using a [[Bow Grip]] [[of the (Profession)|of the Assassin]] to increase the chance for critical hits.
